'''2000 Texas State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Texas in spring 2000. [[Justin Warren]] posted the Light deck he and [[Matt Lush]] rebuilt for it, which went 3-0 there. [[Matt Lush]] also went 3–0 with his Dark Hunt Down deck<ref name="dt-6444">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6444 Matt s Old-Skool Hunt Down], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 7 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6444/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6444/ GitHub Pages].</ref>.<ref name="dt-6874">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6874 Soul Reaver], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 18 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6874/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6874/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 6 May 2000<ref name="tr-d692" />
* '''Site:''' Texas; Austin Sci-Fi Expo, Austin, Texas<ref name="tr-d692" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 63<ref name="tr-d692" />

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Texas State Championship Justin Warren Soul Reaver]] ([[Justin Warren]], [[Light]]; 3–0) — "I took it, going 3-0 with only one close game"
* [[2000 Texas State Championship Matt Lush Matt s Old-Skool Hunt Down]] ([[Matt Lush]], [[Dark]]; 3–0) — "This deck went 3-0 in both the Tulsa GS and the Texas State Championships"
